verdict: Ads went dark two days and cut weekly leads by two-thirds.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 94 leads at $7.40 per lead on $695.90 in ad spend — a solid baseline rate. This past week, Meta advertising paused for two consecutive days (September 12–13), causing leads to drop 66.67% compared to the prior seven days and pushing the short-term cost per lead to roughly $19.85. Delivery has been restored and spending is back in motion. Separately, 92 opportunities are sitting in your CRM from 346 contacts this period with none converted and no appointments recorded, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up — not a problem with the ads themselves. Tightening that intake process is the priority alongside keeping ad delivery stable heading into the next period.

watch_item.fix: We are reviewing the contact-to-appointment workflow now and will identify exactly where leads are going cold so follow-up steps can be tightened before the next reporting period.
